about: Bin screen: the notes deleted in the last 30 days, Restore and Delete forever, the 30-day purge. The delete already writes the note's last version to the bin (cloud.js onCommit); local here until a second kind of app wants it (pantry and hand are likely).
html: the #bin dialog and #open-bin (Settings) in app/index.html; the switch #opt-binScreen
rules: match /spaces/{s}/bin/{id}: allow delete: if mayWrite(s) (restore and purge)
needs: cloud.js: an app.bin = { list, restore, purge } over the bin collection (copy it from notes), and noteOf's collection name
the app's rules: the delete line above, with a rules-test case
docs: Settings → Bin. Entries older than 30 days are purged when the list first draws and when the bin opens.
